root.statement: Build and privately verify an authorized Discord voice control plane while preserving guild authority, privacy, and explicit live-deployment gates.
root.source_state: A public seed repository exists without implementation and live Discord and Cloudflare credentials are not available to source code.
root.target_state: A tested public implementation and private deployment proof exist, with Socialize either verified under staff authority or named as externally blocked.
conditions: Keep live Discord credentials out of the repository.
Do not automate a user account or synthesize activity.
Do not touch the dirty SOL Tools checkout.
root.boundary: The new repository, the user's authorized Discord applications and test guild, the selected personal Cloudflare account, and the explicitly approved Socialize test window.

intent.summary: Ship a reusable official-bot control plane and managed-room bot, prove it privately, then perform only authorized Socialize presence tests.
intent.unknown_disposition: The user owns subjective acceptance and Socialize staff owns target-guild authorization.

decision.summary: Implement local and deployment-ready surfaces before credential-gated external actions.
decision.unknown_disposition: Reopen the host decision if the Cloudflare UDP, DAVE, or lifecycle proof fails.

acceptance_contract.summary: Pass static, unit, integration, private-guild, DAVE, UDP, lifecycle, security, and evidence gates without unsupported claims.
acceptance_contract.unknown_disposition: Private-guild and target-guild runtime acceptance remain open until credentials and approved windows exist.

mechanism.summary: Cloudflare HTTP interactions and Durable Object coordination drive a separately authenticated Discord Gateway and Container voice agent.
mechanism.unknown_disposition: Container UDP, DAVE, and lifecycle behavior require live proof.

current_state_history.summary: The hardened implementation is published on a clean main-only remote at checkpoint 0f52c53; main CI, 77 package tests, and 13 Workers tests pass; SOL Tools remained dirty and protected.
current_state_history.unknown_disposition: Recheck branch, HEAD, credentials, account plan, and live app state before external actions.

people_incentives.summary: The user owns the repository and deployment; Discord guild staff own installation and retention approval; guild members are affected non-users.
people_incentives.unknown_disposition: Do not treat the user's implementation authority as authority over another guild's retention policy.

lifecycle_recovery.summary: Use circuit breakers, version rollback, compensating D1 migrations, token rotation, app removal, and a conventional-host adapter if Cloudflare proof fails.
lifecycle_recovery.unknown_disposition: Live rollback and target removal remain unverified until deployment.

invariants.statement: Do not exceed explicit Discord guild authority, expose credentials, automate a user account, synthesize retention activity, or modify the protected SOL Tools root.

authority.scope: Build, test, publish to main, and deploy the requested official-bot system; live credentials, billing, and target permissions remain human-reserved.
authority.decision_owner: Repository owner for implementation; target-guild staff for Socialize actions
authorized_actions: Create and modify the isolated repository.
Create the public GitHub repository, retain review history, publish verified commits to main, and delete the redundant task branch after exact ref checks.
Deploy to the selected Cloudflare account after the user enables the required paid plan.
Perform ordinary authorized Discord UI setup while respecting confirmation gates.
forbidden_actions: Automate a normal Discord user account or use a user token.
Generate synthetic activity or bypass inactivity policy.
Expose secrets or change billing, security prompts, or target permissions for the user.
Delete a branch that has not been proved redundant with main or is unrelated to this task.
human_reserved_decisions: Cloudflare Workers Paid enrollment, Discord credential creation or revelation, permission confirmation, and Socialize installation approval.

hard_gates.rationale: The user authorized repository creation, implementation, publication, and their own deployment; named human gates remain reserved.
The bounded official-bot design rejects user-token automation, synthetic activity, and voice collection.
Least privilege, signature validation, redaction, no voice collection, and secret isolation are acceptance invariants.
GitHub publication on main and Cloudflare deployment are authorized; billing, credentials, target permissions, and unrelated branch deletion remain gated.
Deployment is in scope only after private evidence and the paid-plan and credential handoffs; destructive cleanup is not authorized.
Billing, credential exposure, permissions, Socialize approval, and subjective acceptance have named human owners.
Worker and container versions can roll back; D1 changes require compensating migration or point-in-time recovery and leave audit residue.

functional_implementation.rationale: Mark applicable only when the root includes player-facing implementation.

runtime_integration.signal: No runnable player-facing surface is in the neutral ledger.
runtime_integration.rationale: Mark applicable when a build or runtime surface exists.

player_eye_presentation.rationale: Delegate observation to Human Eye when a player-facing domain becomes applicable.

evidence_regression_coverage.signal: No player-facing regression claim is present.
evidence_regression_coverage.rationale: Mark applicable with player-facing implementation or acceptance work.

human_acceptance.signal: No subjective player-facing acceptance decision is in scope.
human_acceptance.rationale: Require an explicit human decision whenever subjective acceptance applies.

claims.label: MEASURED
claims.statement: The isolated implementation, documentation, local verification, CI construction, and main publication gates are complete; credential-gated live proof remains external.

confidence.basis: The user-approved plan, generated source, frozen install, static gates, local tests, security scans, and deploy dry-runs support this bounded claim.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.statement: Cloudflare account selection and paid-plan state, live Discord credentials and private-guild behavior, Container UDP and DAVE lifecycle behavior, rollback, and Socialize retention remain unresolved.

confidence.basis: No live-guild or deployed Container evidence exists yet.

evidence.integrity: Project decisions transcribed from the user-approved implementation plan without expanding authority.
Sanitized summary of frozen install, formatting, lint, typecheck, builds, 77 package tests, 13 Workers tests, wording, secret, dependency, skill, and deploy-bundle checks.

Sanitized Wrangler evidence: a prior selected account required Workers Paid, while the current non-interactive check found two accounts and no configured selection; account identifiers and raw logs are excluded.
Exact pre-window-discovery helper error retained without credentials or screenshots.
Requirement-by-requirement matrix derived from the approved plan, current main source, verbose local tests, GitHub state, and separately labelled external live gates.
Sanitized read-only gate check: required Cloudflare and Discord variables are unset and no ignored live secret file exists; no values or account identifiers are recorded.

bounds.stop_rule: Expand only branches that can change action, acceptance, mitigation, monitoring, rollback, residual risk, or a human decision.

nodes.statement: Implement and test the local system while preserving live-deployment and authority gates.

decision.recommendation: Keep the main implementation unchanged and hand Cloudflare account selection and paid-plan state, protected Discord setup, and Socialize authorization to their named human owners before any live action.
rejected_options: Do not begin with Socialize or a production voice connection before private-guild and hosting proof.
decision.human_owner: Repository owner and authorized Discord or Cloudflare account owner
decision.reopen_trigger: Re-evaluate architecture if current official APIs, the DAVE stack, Container UDP or lifecycle proof, or target-guild authorization contradicts the plan.

mechanism.signal: Signed envelopes, replay, migration-backed Durable Object state, relay limits, managed rooms, voice state transitions, and agent WebSocket behavior pass local tests.
mechanism.rationale: The local mechanism is exercised without treating mocks or local sockets as live Discord voice evidence.

endpoint.rationale: Separate the real objective from its proxy before endpoint verification.

guardrails.signal: Authorization, least privilege, secret scanning, copy triage, relay suppression, redaction, and protected-root boundaries pass their recorded checks.
guardrails.rationale: These checks support the local guardrail claim; live guild permissions remain separately unverified.

recovery.signal: No rollback or recovery test has run.
recovery.rationale: Distinguish true rollback from compensating recovery and test it when applicable.

closure.summary: Implementation, documentation, local verification, CI construction, and main publication are complete. Cloudflare deployment, private-guild proof, rollback, and Socialize evidence remain externally blocked or unverified.
residual_risks: Cloudflare Containers may fail a live UDP, DAVE, native-library, or lifecycle gate.
Socialize may not approve installation or a supported retention mechanism.
nonclaims: This ledger does not contain hidden chain-of-thought.
This ledger does not guarantee correctness or completeness.
This ledger does not grant human acceptance.
